title: 8 HR questions your AI agent can answer right away
summary: See 8 HR questions your AI agent can answer instantly, from compensation by department to missing pay info, using live data via MCP.
body_markdown:
What’s the point of an HR data revolution and an age of AI if you still have to open four screens and export a spreadsheet to find out how many people were hired last quarter?


An AI agent can surface the answer in seconds.


It doesn't matter much how you connect. MCP,[Plane Agent](https://plane.com/blog/plane-agent-is-now-in-the-plane-app) , or an[open API and CLI](https://plane.com/developers) if you have engineering support. The work is the same on your end. Type the question or request, and an answer comes back from live records.


If you’re ready to move on from manual lookup, start with this list of 8 questions.


## 1. Which workers are missing info before they can get paid?


A contractor's first payment is stuck and nobody knows why. Before the issue turns into a Slack thread, your agent can pull every worker missing required info: no W-9, an unconfirmed bank account, a half-finished profile. Fixed before it becomes a problem.


## 2. What’s our average compensation by department?


A board member wants to know how engineering compares to sales. That's not a number sitting on any single screen, but your agent pulls comp across the roster and breaks it down by department. You email numbers that afternoon instead of a week later.


## 3. How much have we paid \[contractor name\] this year?


Tax season, a budget review, a contractor asking for a summary. Your agent pulls the full payment history and customizes it to your preferences. No spreadsheet gymnastics.


## 4. Who have we added in the last 90 days?


Hiring fast means the roster outruns whatever spreadsheet was tracking it. But it’s no problem for your agent. Give it a date range, and it returns a breakdown with name, classification, and location. Handy before a board update, a compliance review, or any time someone asks how big the team is.


## 5. How are our workers classified across the roster?


Misclassification is an expensive mistake to find out about later. Your agent surfaces who's an employee and who's a contractor, across every jurisdiction. Auditing worker classification used to take an afternoon, now it takes a few minutes.


## 6. What is our total workforce spend right now?


Not last quarter. Right now. Your agent pulls current workforce cost and presents total spend, by worker type, and across regions. Next time your CFO asks, you can reply in minutes instead of assembling numbers from three different places.


## 7. Which employees haven't gotten a raise in the longest time?


Attrition is easy to miss until someone's updated their LinkedIn profile. Your agent surfaces who has gone the longest without a compensation change, so you can get ahead of it instead of finding out in an exit interview.


## 8. Who has open leave requests right now?


This comes up every time a request sits for days and nobody notices. Your agent pulls every leave request pending, so nothing goes stale. You get real-time leave visibility without checking a master spreadsheet.
